'''Argat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] who served the armed forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he accompanied [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] to a secret base on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] where they held a scientist captive.
